source.author: hor
source.text: nam vitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est, qui minimis urgetur.
source.text_original: nam vitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est,  / qui minimis urgetur.
source.text_english: for no one is born without faults; that man is best who is pressed by the fewest.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quam ob rem et grauissimus poeta Flaccus scribit in satira: nam uitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est, qui minimis urgetur.
reuse.text_original: quam ob rem et grauissimus poeta Flaccus scribit in satira: nam uitiis nemo sine nascitur; optimus ille est, qui minimis urgetur.
reuse.text_english: For this reason too the very serious poet Flaccus writes in a satire: for no one is born without faults; the best man is the one who is burdened by the fewest.
